title: Marie Curie: A Life for Science
subtitle: 考点：人物经历 / Nobel Prize, physicist, wounded
passage: Marie Curie was born in Poland in 1867. Her family was not rich, and she worked as a private teacher at a young age to save money. Later she went to Paris to study physics and chemistry. In Paris she met Pierre Curie, a physicist, and they got married.

Marie worked very hard with her husband. They found two new elements. She won the Nobel Prize in Physics, and later she won a second Nobel Prize, in chemistry. She was the first person to win two Nobel Prizes. During the war, she also helped wounded soldiers with X-ray machines on cars.
